changelog:
Initial release of pork-cutting-spec skill, providing comprehensive technical guidelines for pork cutting based on GB/T 40466-2021.

- Covers terminology, raw material requirements, workshop setup, detailed cutting procedures (hot and cold), labeling, packaging, storage, and transport.
- Includes step-by-step instructions for segmenting pork carcasses into forequarter, midsection, and hindquarter, with clear process flows.
- Provides quality standards for environment, operation timings, and finished product requirements.
- Lists references to relevant national standards for further details on terminology, meat part identification, packaging, and transport.
